name: method-smelt-v4-muon
preserved: 3 core layers run 4 times with shared core owners between 3 independent prefix and 3 suffix layers: 18 effective layers, as in SMELT's 2-visit P2 path.
Both core attention/FFN residuals use 1/4; independent prelude/coda use 1.
Fixed depth, full BPTT, terminal cross entropy.
adaptations: Common RMSNorm/RoPE/SwiGLU cells, softmax top-k with selected-weight normalization and dropless dispatch.

Track P2's Muon for hidden matrices (AdamW for embedding, head, routers, norms and other 1-D parameters) and independently owned input embedding/output head; no original-paper quality or scaling claim.
Publicly reconstructible DCLM replaces the original private corpus; the frozen manifest and tokenizer are separate comparison identities.
Physical active counts name one traversal of unique cells; repeated core calls still incur compute.
P2 public-stack intermediate/head geometry is selected by a predeclared 32-shape analytical budget screen, without quality observations.

SMELT's prefix and suffix expert count (E88 instead of the paper's E96) and core expert count are explicit resource-matching adaptations; expert pool and head dimensions differ, so this is a recipe comparison, not a pure loop ablation.
Geometry: P2 SMELT with 3 core layers run 4 times instead of 6 run twice keeps 3 + 3 x 4 + 3 = 18 effective layers, and 179 core experts instead of 88 meet m0's unique parameters.

Matrix initialization std=.02 and unit norm scales are P2's; seq 4096, 1,048,576 positions per update, the schedule (95-update linear warmup, constant peak, last 20% linear to 0) and the AdamW or Muon settings are Track P2's; the training recipe (objective, depth, aux coefficient, expert LR multiplier) is the constructor's.
